fieldNotes.location: Confirmed General Mills food-manufacturing plant in Murfreesboro TN (makes Yoplait yogurt, Toaster Strudel, and Pillsbury products). The roster geocode was RANGE_INTERPOLATED and moved 3274m; satellite + web research locked the actual plant center at 35.8010,-86.3915. Plant address is 2695 Stevenson Dr / 2533 General Mills Way. Active manufacturing confirmed by steam plumes in 2026 Street View.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE. The campus is fully enclosed by a black ornamental metal perimeter fence (clearly visible along the road on multiple sides in 2019/2026 Street View). Wide controlled internal road (Stevenson Dr / General Mills Way) serves the plant. Treated as a controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Not definitively confirmed. A small white booth-like structure was seen near the road at the entrance area in Street View/satellite, which may be a gate/guard house, but it could not be positively confirmed as a staffed truck-gate booth. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true on the assumption of a gate without a confirmed staffed booth; low confidence - flagged.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band. Multiple dock banks: a long dock face with trailers backed in (seen behind the fence in Street View) on the warehouse buildings, plus additional docks. Estimated ~55-65 total.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ band. Several large trailer drop yards: rows of parked trailers in the SW, S-central, and W lots - well over 100 trailer stalls combined.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus comprises the dense central process building, large warehouse buildings, a separate dark-roof building, on-site wastewater treatment, and supporting structures - multiple distinct clusters.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity is spread across separate building faces (warehouse dock banks on different sides), supporting separate ship/receive clusters.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide internal roads and large aprons leave room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the E edge of the property; rail spurs appear to serve the site. Set true but flagged - the spur penetration into the plant is not fully confirmed in imagery.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively identified; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box ~186 acres; the developed paved/built core is roughly 90-110 acres.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located within the Murfreesboro / Nashville metro fabric beside I-24 with surrounding industrial and residential development; classified Urban.
